summary: Backend fully verified with pytest (13/14 pass; 1 failure is a test-race between parallel workers, not a real bug). Frontend Home screen loads correctly, search + filter chips work; Add Customer modal opens but its submit button rendered outside the 390x844 viewport (bottom-sheet extends beyond screen). Dial->status modal, tabs, settings goal update, paste import, and clear-all confirm modal could not be fully re-run in the same script after the Add-modal error, but earlier screenshot confirms 4 tabs are rendered and the header calls counter is wired (0/100 -> 1/100 observed).

minor.issue: Passed functionally; only test-suite race with clear-all under pytest-xdist -n auto caused 1 spurious failure. Not an API bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit button (testID=submit-add-customer) is positioned outside the 390x844 viewport in Expo web preview — the bottom sheet content overflows the visible area (no scroll inside sheet and no KeyboardAvoidingView). User on small phones may not see/tap the Add button.

issues: Bottom sheet not scrollable; no KeyboardAvoidingView; primary CTA can be clipped on small viewports

Metric box shows '1/100' immediately on load in this run — verify counter is actually today-scoped after cross-midnight boundary; call_logs use UTC date_key which may confuse users in non-UTC timezones

action_items: Wrap Add Customer and Paste sheet content in ScrollView + KeyboardAvoidingView so submit button stays visible/tappable on small screens (esp. web preview at 390x844).
Consider date_key using user's local timezone (or expose TZ to server) so stats/today matches user-perceived 'today'.
Optional: change delete_customer test isolation (mark clear-all test as serial) — no code fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly projects _id out in all endpoints (verified programmatically). Good.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.
index.tsx AddCustomerModal has no KeyboardAvoidingView / ScrollView — root cause of the viewport clipping bug.
api.ts BASE has no fallback — if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL missing, fetch will hit /api on undefined host. Fine because env is set, but worth a runtime guard.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (home/search/filter/tab-render verified; add-submit blocked by viewport issue; dial-status + settings flows not fully re-run)

seed_data_creation: Bulk-reseeded original 5 sample customers (Alice/Bob/Carla/David/Emma) after clear-all test. Also created a TEST_UI_User via UI (may still exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid — reuse /app/backend/tests/test_callflow_api.py. For frontend, after main agent adds KeyboardAvoidingView+ScrollView inside the Add and Paste sheets, retest: Add Customer submit, Dial->status update (verify calls-count increments), Progress/History tab content, Paste import (2 rows), Clear-all confirm+delete flow. Sample seed data is present; goal is 100.
rca_of_issue: Add Customer submit button unreachable on 390x844 web viewport. RCA: The Modal 'sheet' View has fixed padding (theme.space.xl top + xxl bottom) plus two 48px TextInputs, a possible error line, and a 52px primary button — total content height exceeds available bottom-sheet area at the smallest common mobile viewport when keyboard is shown. No inner ScrollView and no KeyboardAvoidingView. Fix: wrap sheet content in <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS==='ios'?'padding':'height'}><ScrollView>...</ScrollView></KeyboardAvoidingView> and cap sheet maxHeight to '85%' of screen.
